recipes.name: Chocolate Hazelnut & Fig Granola
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 325°F (160°C)*.
Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, agave syrup, and salt until very well combined.
Pour this wet mixture over the dry ingredients and toss to coat.
Evenly distribute over the baking tray.
Bake on the centre rack of the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until lightly golden, stirring once or twice throughout. Once cooled, stir in the add-ins.
Transfer to an airtight container or large glass storage jar. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store sealed and on the counter for up to 3 weeks.
